title: CaptureBoxes
description: Boxes of one capture (spec §7, §15). All rects are in device pixels: CSS px of the page rendered at the panel's logical size, times `scale`. Both sides (exporter goldens and Unity captures) follow the rules in the property descriptions.

elements.description: One entry per IR element id.

x.description: Border box: the axis-aligned bounds after transforms (Chromium getBoundingClientRect, Unity worldBound). An element without a box (display: none on it or an ancestor, display: contents) has x = y = w = h = 0.

visible.description: The element has a box, its computed visibility is visible, and neither it nor an ancestor has a computed opacity of 0 (so an animation sample at opacity 0 is not visible). Clipping by overflow and placement outside the viewport are ignored. A display: contents element is not visible and has a zero box.

text.description: The IR element carries text (IrNode.text is not null).

rotation.description: Design side only, optional: the element's rotation on the screen in degrees, its own rotate and transform plus its ancestors', in (-180, 180]; absent when it is 0. Unity captures do not write it.

lines.description: Text lines of the element's own text (text inside nested IR elements is excluded), top to bottom: one per baseline (text fragments whose baselines are within 0.5 device px form one line, whatever the line height). The lines are the laid-out lines, also those clipped by overflow. A line's rect is the union of its text fragments' boxes (font ascent + descent, not the line-height box); its width is the laid-out width (for text-overflow: ellipsis, the whole text's width). Empty for elements without a box and for form controls whose text is not in DOM text (input, select, textarea): compare their lines as not compared.

external.description: Ids of data-u-external elements, sorted; their regions are masked in comparisons.

items.description: Optional: the IR elements' copies in later written-out repeat items, keyed by the IR id plus a suffix: `#k` per repeat, innermost first, for each repeat whose item is a later one (k > 0) or that sits inside a later item of an outer repeat (`row#3`, `day#0#1`). Border box, visibility, `text` and `lines` as for elements (`text`: the IR element carries text; `lines`: the copy's own text lines, leaving out text inside nested elements and their copies). The comparison places the edge bands of a repeat's later items with the boxes and masks and checks the copies' text lines as the IR elements' text.

baseline.description: Line top plus the rendered ascent of the line's font at its size (findings R7).
